column1: # Independent annotation of the frozen diagnostic slice v1 (bench/slice_v1.txt). Written by reading ONLY the question text (and, for follow-ups, the previous question), before looking at any gold interpretation or model output; it records what the person SAID, not what the evaluator's gold normalises it to.
# Columns (TAB): id, requested result, statistic, interval phrase (verbatim), restriction phrase (verbatim), number(s) with unit, selection phrase, for follow-ups what changes, note.

# requested result vocabulary: latest_value | summary | extreme | count | existence | list | time_share | comparison | change_timing | explanation | context | trend | ranking | relationship | capability | domain_check | refuse | unsupported ;  '-' = none stated.

column9: than it used to is a comparison with the past, not a stated interval

column5: on the highway / in the city

column9: how long = duration in the state
how often: share vs episode count is ambiguous in the wording
count the minutes = duration in the state
polite request for the current value

column8: interval: last week -> last two weeks

column9: value at the time of the event; wording is ambiguous (a value inside the event window)
fragment: "how many" is implied (a list would also be a reading)
